import pandas as pd, numpy as np, time, json
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
# normalize column names underscores to hyphens, then map layout order
col_map = {c: c.replace('_','-') for c in counts.columns}
counts = counts.rename(columns=col_map)
layout = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/sample_layout.csv')
print('layout shape', layout.shape)
# map by SampleID
meta = layout.set_index('SampleID')[['Group']].copy()
# ensure same order as counts; counts already 1-1 etc
print('all samples in meta', meta.index.isin(counts.columns).all())
print('counts not in meta', [c for c in counts.columns if c not in meta.index])
counts = counts[meta.index]
meta['group'] = pd.Categorical(meta['Group'], categories=['DMSO','CBD_IC50','Untreated','Serum_starvation','DMSO_Serum_starvation','Cisplatin_IC50','Cisplatin_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h','CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h','Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50','Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h'])
meta = meta[['group']]
# PyDESeq2 wants counts rows samples, columns genes
ct = counts.T.copy()
ct.index.name='sample'
print('counts orient', ct.shape, ct.index[:3], ct.columns[:3])
t0=time.time()
dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=ct, metadata=meta, design='~group', quiet=False, n_cpus=4)
print('built', time.time()-t0)
t0=time.time()
dds.deseq2()
print('fit done', time.time()-t0)
print(dds.obsm['design_matrix'].columns.tolist())
print(dds.obsm['design_matrix'].head())
# save dds? Use pickle maybe but object may contain anndata. Save results via stats.
t0=time.time()
stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'], alpha=0.05, independent_filter=True, cooks_filter=True, n_cpus=4)
stat.summary()
print('stats done', time.time()-t0)
res = stat.results_df.copy()
print('res shape', res.shape)
print(res.head())
print(res['padj'].notna().sum(), (res['padj']<0.05).sum())
print('sig', ((res['padj']<0.05)&(res['log2FoldChange'].abs()>0.5)).sum())
res.to_csv('/workspace/tmp/deseq2_cbd_vs_dmso.tsv', sep='\\t')
print('saved')
PY"

mp=pd.read_csv('/workspace/tmp/sig_symbols.tsv',sep='\\t').dropna(subset=['symbol']).drop_duplicates('symbol')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, time
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
counts = pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
counts.columns=[c.replace('_','-') for c in counts.columns]
layout=pd.read_csv('/workspace/inputs/sample_layout.csv').set_index('SampleID')
sel=[s for s in counts.columns if s.split('-')[0] in ['3','7']]
sub=counts[sel]
# variants
variants={
 'total6_ge5': sub[sub.sum(axis=1)>=5],
 'total6_ge10': sub[sub.sum(axis=1)>=10],
 'pergroup_total_ge5': sub[(sub[[s for s in sel if s.startswith('3-')]].sum(axis=1)>=5)&(sub[[s for s in sel if s.startswith('7-')]].sum(axis=1)>=5)],
 'each_sample_ge1': sub[(sub>0).sum(axis=1)>=3],
}
for name,ct_counts in variants.items():
    print('\\nVARIANT',name,ct_counts.shape)
    meta=layout.loc[sel,['Group']].copy(); meta['group']=pd.Categorical(meta['Group'], categories=['DMSO','CBD_IC50'])
    ct=ct_counts.T.copy(); ct.index.name='sample'
    dds=DeseqDataSet(counts=ct, metadata=meta[['group']], design='~group', quiet=True, n_cpus=4)
    dds.deseq2()
    stat=DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'], alpha=0.05, independent_filter=True, cooks_filter=True, n_cpus=4)
    stat.summary()
    res=stat.results_df
    sig=res[(res.padj<0.05)&(res.log2FoldChange.abs()>0.5)]
    print('sig',len(sig),'up',(sig.log2FoldChange>0).sum(),'down',(sig.log2FoldChange<0).sum(),'padj_notna',res.padj.notna().sum())
    res.to_csv(f'/workspace/tmp/deseq2_pairwise_{name}.tsv',sep='\\t')
PY"

import pandas as pd, gseapy, re, json, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
# load DE files and map symbols
from pathlib import Path
files={
'pairwise_no_filter':'/workspace/tmp/deseq2_pairwise_6samples.tsv',
'pairwise_total6_ge10':'/workspace/tmp/deseq2_pairwise_total6_ge10.tsv',
'all_groups_no_filter':'/workspace/tmp/deseq2_cbd_vs_dmso.tsv',
}
# symbol mapping cache from earlier? do mygene per file quickly
import mygene
mg=mygene.MyGeneInfo()
lib='GO_Biological_Process_2023'
gs=gseapy.get_library(name=lib, organism='human')
print('lib terms', len(gs), 'sample', list(gs.items())[0])
# background all genes in library (unique)
bg=sorted({g for genes in gs.values() for g in genes})
print('bg size', len(bg))
metab_re=re.compile(r'metabol|glycol|glucose|carbohydrate|lipid|fatty acid|cholesterol|oxidative|energy|gluconeogen|monosaccharide|hexose', re.I)
for name,path in files.items():
    res=pd.read_csv(path,sep='\\t',index_col=0)
    sig=res[(res.padj<0.05)&(res.log2FoldChange.abs()>0.5)]
    ids=sig.index.tolist()
    out=mg.querymany(ids, scopes='ensembl.gene', fields='symbol', species='human', verbose=False)
    syms=[]
    for d in out:
        s=d.get('symbol')
        if isinstance(s,list): s=s[0] if s else None
        if s: syms.append(s)
    # map direction
    mp={d.get('query'): (d.get('symbol')[0] if isinstance(d.get('symbol'),list) else d.get('symbol')) for d in out if d.get('symbol')}
    sig=sig.copy(); sig['symbol']=[mp.get(i) for i in sig.index]; sig=sig.dropna(subset=['symbol'])
    up=sig[sig.log2FoldChange>0]['symbol'].tolist(); down=sig[sig.log2FoldChange<0]['symbol'].tolist()
    print('\\n===',name,'DEG',len(sig),'up',len(up),'down',len(down))
    for direction, genes in [('up',up),('down',down)]:
        genes=[g for g in genes if g in bg]
        try:
            er=gseapy.enrich(gene_list=genes, gene_sets=gs, background=bg, outdir=None, no_plot=True, verbose=False)
            df=er.res2d.copy()
            # adjusted p column maybe 'Adjusted P-value' in custom? inspect
            print(direction, 'res2d cols', df.columns.tolist())
            # normalize cols
            pcol=[c for c in df.columns if 'Adjusted' in c][0]
            termcol=[c for c in df.columns if c.lower()=='term'][0]
            df[pcol]=pd.to_numeric(df[pcol],errors='coerce')
            sigdf=df[df[pcol]<0.05]
            print(direction, 'total sig terms',len(sigdf))
            metab=sigdf[sigdf[termcol].str.contains(metab_re,regex=True,na=False)]
            print(direction, 'metabolic sig terms',len(metab))
            print(metab[[termcol,pcol,'Overlap','Genes']].head(20).to_string(index=False))
        except Exception as e:
            print(direction,'ERR',type(e).__name__,e)
PY"
